h1: Custom 40 oz Koozies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 40 oz koozies in bulk for your brand. Perfect for large drinks and outdoor events. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom 40 oz koozies are built for the oversized drink trend—think big tumblers, giant cans, and extra-large bottles. Unlike standard koozies that only fit 12 oz cans, these sleeves accommodate 40 oz vessels, making them ideal for construction site crews, outdoor festivals, or corporate tailgates where hydration matters. Decorate with full-color imprint or laser engraving for a durable, premium look that stands out on job sites or at brand activations.
heroAltText: Custom 40 oz koozies with full-color imprint, fitting oversized tumblers and large bottles
